phase_rules.REVIEW: status is OPEN or SATISFIED; SATISFIED needs non-empty evidence and is set only through a reviewed change, never by a tool
phase_rules.ARTIFACT: status is always PRODUCED_AT_STAGE; the harness verifies it (PRE_EXECUTION: named verifier over real files, the build-input fingerprint and the local images; ACCEPTANCE: a regular JSON file); the lock can never claim it
phase_rules.PRE_BUILD: must be fully satisfied before an approved construction step (harness.py build)
phase_rules.PRE_EXECUTION: must be satisfied, together with PRE_BUILD, before harness.py run; produced by the build plus review
phase_rules.ACCEPTANCE: after the run; never gates build or run; reported as open until produced and reviewed

requirements.description: Security review of the proof sources (SECURITY-REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md S1-S19)
requirements.evidence: PR #56 Security approval record (comment 6200838093), user-declared sole Security authority, reviewing original source commit 5d7f88035cd25f184572df9969b4411188afd8bc. CONDITIONAL construction-only acceptance of S1-S19 recorded in SECURITY-REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md. Accepted risks: shared VM/root-equivalent Docker operator, Docker-managed mounts, trusted-operator same-user path-string race, unsigned base attestations, arm64-only, unreproduced image IDs, bitmap synthetic-only CER limitations, residual Tesseract/Leptonica parsers. Syft chosen for SBOM/licences, Grype for vulnerability scan; exact versions/digests, acquisition/operation and all PE/AC controls remain unapproved or unverified. Neither Docker start nor execution authorized. FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-16: First actual build failed closed on Docker Desktop's kernel-created down virtual interfaces. The approved S1-S19 evaluation covered source commit 5d7f880, not the proposed offline-network-guard refactor. CONDITIONAL SOURCE RE-REVIEW REQUIRED before another full build; earlier decision remains historical evidence. Build authorization PB-14 does not override PB-13. DECISION 2026-10-21: PR #56 comment 6318871714 (https://github.com/nishanth-cryptos/TrustLens/pull/56#issuecomment-6318871714, posted by nishanth-cryptos 2026-10-21T14:45:29Z). Residual risks accepted only for the disposable worker proof: root-equivalent Docker operator and shared Docker Desktop VM, unsigned image attestations, unverified on-host Debian mawk/kernel table representations, BuildKit isolation/build results unproven. The guard must reject unrecognized live data and must not be weakened to make a build pass. This updates only the reopened PB-13 source-review condition within the historical S1-S19 conditional construction review; it is not S8 integration or activation approval, not independent authentication of the Security owner and not an external audit. Any future build-affecting revision requires renewed disposition. FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-21 (after the decision above): the authorized build retry failed at runtime stage 5/7 with 'untraversable directory under /opt/tl' (BuildKit gives the directory a COPY --chmod=0444 creates that same mode). The build-affecting correction (explicit root chmod 0555 of the COPY-created /opt/tl/worker and /opt/tl/probe, permission guards that list each offending path and mode, and the matching static review) is NOT covered by the b62efb1a0dfe904daec9fd769de353776ad94b3a decision. RENEWED DECISION 2026-10-21: PR #56 comment 6320631134 (https://github.com/nishanth-cryptos/TrustLens/pull/56#issuecomment-6320631134, posted by nishanth-cryptos 2026-10-21T16:09:55Z).
